gloss: business failure; corporate collapse; management breakdown

definitions.explanation: The failure or collapse of a business, typically due to financial difficulties. A formal term frequently used in news and business contexts.

examples.japanese: その{会社|かいしゃ}は{経営|けいえい}{破綻|はたん}に{追|お}い{込|こ}まれた。
examples.english: The company was driven into business failure.

examples.japanese: {経営|けいえい}{破綻|はたん}した{銀行|ぎんこう}の{預金者|よきんしゃ}は{不安|ふあん}を{感|かん}じている。
examples.english: Depositors of the failed bank are feeling anxious.

examples.japanese: {過大|かだい}な{投資|とうし}と{売上|うりあげ}の{減少|げんしょう}が{重|かさ}なり、{経営|けいえい}{破綻|はたん}に{至|いた}った。
examples.english: Excessive investment combined with declining sales led to corporate collapse.

notes:
Compound of {経営|けいえい} (management; business operation) + {破綻|はたん} (failure; collapse; breakdown). A formal term seen frequently in news reports, financial articles, and legal contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {経営|けいえい}{破綻|はたん}に{陥|おちい}る: to fall into business failure
- {経営|けいえい}{破綻|はたん}に{追|お}い{込|こ}まれる: to be driven to collapse
- {経営|けいえい}{破綻|はたん}に{至|いた}る: to result in business failure
- {経営|けいえい}{破綻|はたん}した{企業|きぎょう}: a company that has failed
- {経営|けいえい}{破綻|はたん}を{防|ふせ}ぐ: to prevent business failure

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {倒産|とうさん}: bankruptcy; going out of business — more common in everyday speech, specifically means ceasing operations
- {破産|はさん}: bankruptcy (legal) — a legal declaration of inability to pay debts
- {廃業|はいぎょう}: closing a business — voluntary cessation, not necessarily due to financial failure
